rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something relating to or looking back on the past, especially in titles or descriptions.

example.english: This retrospective exhibition showcases the director’s work over many years.
example.traditional: 呢個回顧性展覽展出咗導演多年來嘅作品。

rows.note: Use this in legal, tax, or policy contexts when a rule or decision affects an earlier period.

example.english: This new tax rule is retrospective and will collect tax that was underpaid in the previous year.
example.traditional: 呢項有追溯效力嘅新稅例，會追收上一年度少交嘅稅。
example.jyutping: ne1 hong6 jau5 zeoi1 sou3 haau6 lik6 ge3 san1 seoi3 lai6 wui5 zeoi1 sau1 soeng6 jat1 nin4 dou6 siu2 gaau1 ge3 seoi3

rows.note: Use this instead of 回顧性 when “looking backwards” is literal, such as a person or animal looking behind itself.

example.english: The dog by the door gives a retrospective glance as it walks.
example.traditional: 門口嗰隻向後望嘅狗一路行，一路望返轉頭。
